name: Kill the Night
source:
Following the untimely passing of his father, Sasaki Shin'ya and his mother moved to a countryside town called Hinoyama, where they now run a café together.

Apart from his job, he has become withdrawn and no longer has any passion. What he seeks is a peaceful and uneventful day-to-day life.

Under the dark winter sky, on a day like any other—multiple people were found dead inside an initially assumed single victim, in a park he passes by everyday.

On the same day, by the twist of an inevitable fate, he met a woman he never should have.

That same night, he died. 

Then he woke up—40 years later. 

[From [url=https://hiera.itch.io/kill-the-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
父亲去世后，佐佐木新也和母亲搬到了一个名叫日野山的乡村小镇，现在他们一起经营一家咖啡馆。

除了工作之外，他变得孤僻，不再有任何热情。他所追求的是平淡无奇的日常生活。

在冬日黑暗的天空下，在一个和往常一样的日子里，在一名最初假设的单一受害者体内发现了多人死亡，地点是在他每天经过的一个公园里。

就在同一天，命运的转折，他遇到了一个他不该遇到的女人。

当天晚上，他就去世了。

然后他醒了——四十年后。

[来自[url=https://hiera.itch.io/kill-the-night]Itch.io[/url]]
